login.title: Log in
login.submit_hint: Signs in with the email and password entered above

two_factor_challenge.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor_challenge.description: Enter your authenticator code, or use a registered security key.
two_factor_challenge.error_security_key: Could not verify your security key. Please try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.password_helper: At least 12 characters. Avoid common or easily guessed passwords.
register.submit_hint: Creates an account with the email and password entered above
register.success_message: If that email isn't already in use, we've sent a link to verify your account. Click it to finish signing up.
register.error_default: Unable to create your account. Please try again.
register.signup_closed: New account registration is closed right now. If you were invited to an existing organization, use the link in your invitation email instead.

forgot_password.title: Reset your password
forgot_password.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot_password.submit_hint: Emails a password reset link to the address entered above
forgot_password.success_message: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to reset your password.
forgot_password.error_default: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reset_password.title: Choose a new password
reset_password.password_helper: At least 12 characters. Avoid common or easily guessed passwords.
reset_password.submit_hint: Saves the new password entered above
reset_password.invalid_message: This password reset link is invalid. Please request a new one.
reset_password.success_message: Your password has been reset. You can now log in with your new password.
reset_password.error_invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

verify_email.success_message: Your email is verified. You can now log in to your account.
verify_email.error_default: This link is invalid. Please check your email for the correct link.
verify_email.error_invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid or has expired.

magic_link.title: Sign in with a magic link
magic_link.description: We'll email you a link to sign in without a password.
magic_link.submit_hint: Emails a sign-in link to the address entered above
magic_link.success_message: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link you can use to sign in.
magic_link.error_default: Something went wrong. Please try again.
magic_link.error_invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid or has expired.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
two_factor.scan_instruction: Scan this in your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually:
two_factor.backup_codes_notice: Save these backup codes — they won't be shown again:

security_keys.description: Register a hardware security key or platform authenticator (e.g. a YubiKey, Touch ID, or Windows Hello) as an alternative to a 2FA code.
security_keys.error_load: Unable to load your security keys.
security_keys.error_register: Unable to register this security key.
security_keys.error_revoke: Unable to remove this security key.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account.

oauth_callback.error_message: We couldn't complete that sign-in. Please try again.

password_validation.min_length: Password must be at least 12 characters
password_validation.max_length: Password must be at most 128 characters
password_validation.common_password: Password is too common — choose something less guessable

change_password.description: Update the password you use to sign in.
change_password.password_helper: At least 12 characters. Avoid common or easily guessed passwords.
change_password.success_message: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been signed out.
change_password.error_default: Unable to change your password. Check your current password and try again.

change_email.description: Change the email address you use to sign in.
change_email.current_password_helper: Not required if you only sign in with Google/GitHub.
change_email.success_message: Check the new address's inbox for a confirmation link. Your email won't change until you click it. We've also emailed your current address a link to cancel this request if you didn't make it.
change_email.error_default: Unable to start the email change. Please try again.

confirm_email_change.success_message: Your account email has been updated. You can now log in with your new address.
confirm_email_change.error_default: This link is invalid. Please check your email for the correct link.
confirm_email_change.error_invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid or has expired.

cancel_email_change.success_message: The pending email change has been cancelled. Your account email is unchanged, and the confirmation link that was sent no longer works.
cancel_email_change.error_default: This link is invalid. Please check your email for the correct link.
cancel_email_change.error_invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid, has expired, or has already been used.

linked_accounts.title: Linked accounts
linked_accounts.description: Sign-in providers connected to your account.
linked_accounts.error_unlink: Unable to unlink this provider. It may be your only sign-in method.
